account_info_header.details: Edit page header shows account number (ACC000062) in emerald badge and account name (Sujal Sharaf) below the 'Edit Account' title

rich_text_editor.details: Quill editor with snow theme. Toolbar has B/I/U, ordered/bullet lists, alignment (left/center/right), and clear formatting. HTML stored and rendered with DOMPurify sanitization.

numeric_input_validation.details: Weight, Amount, Interest inputs are type='text' with inputMode='decimal'. Regex /^\d*\.?\d*$/ allows only digits and single decimal point. Letters and special chars are rejected.

confirmation_dialog.details: ConfirmDialog component shows before save. Title: 'Confirm Update'/'Confirm Create'. Message: 'Are you sure you want to update/create this entry?'. Buttons: Cancel, Yes Update/Create.

status_filter_dropdown.details: Status filter has 5 options: All Status (empty), Continue, Closed, Renewed, Immediate Action Needed

default_date_range.details: getDefaultStartDate() subtracts 90 days from today. Default range is 90 days, not 30.

filter_persistence.details: Filters saved to localStorage key 'lendledger_accounts_filters' on Apply. Restored on page load. Clear button removes localStorage entry.

image_zoom.details: Image viewer modal has zoom in/out buttons (data-testid='zoom-in-btn', 'zoom-out-btn'), zoom level display (100%, 125%, etc.), Reset button, and fullscreen button (data-testid='fullscreen-btn').

fullscreen_image.details: Fullscreen overlay with black background, close button (data-testid='close-fullscreen-btn'), and navigation arrows for multiple images.

new_account_image_note.details: New account form shows italic note: 'Images can be uploaded after saving the account.' below jewellery items section.

critical_code_review_comments: AccountFormPage.js: Quill editor properly configured with modules (toolbar) and formats (bold, italic, underline, list, align)
AccountFormPage.js: handleNumericInput uses regex /^\d*\.?\d*$/ for numeric validation
AccountFormPage.js: DOMPurify.sanitize() called on formData.details before save (line 400)
AccountFormPage.js: ConfirmDialog component with isEdit-based title/message
AccountsPage.js: getDefaultStartDate() subtracts 90 days from today
AccountsPage.js: loadFilters() and saveFilters() handle localStorage persistence
AccountDetailPage.js: DOMPurify.sanitize() called on account.details in dangerouslySetInnerHTML (line 277)
AccountDetailPage.js: zoomLevel state with setZoomLevel for zoom controls
AccountDetailPage.js: showFullscreen state for fullscreen overlay
